assessment.executive_summary: The repository implements a compact customer onboarding service. It accepts onboarding requests, validates customer data, prevents duplicate e-mail addresses, calls an external KYC provider, calculates a risk score, activates low-risk customers or routes risky cases to manual review, persists the customer and publishes an onboarding event.
assessment.system_purpose: Start and track customer onboarding with KYC-based risk assessment and customer status management.

top_risks.title: Risk threshold is duplicated
top_risks.description: The service uses a hard-coded threshold of 70 while configuration also defines risk.threshold.

top_risks.title: Tests are only placeholders
top_risks.description: The test class names relevant scenarios but does not contain assertions in this demo repository.

recommended_next_steps.title: Move risk threshold into configuration
recommended_next_steps.reason: This prevents divergence between configuration and implementation.

recommended_next_steps.title: Turn scenario tests into executable assertions
recommended_next_steps.reason: The repository already names important test scenarios but the methods are empty.

open_questions: The repository does not show authentication or authorization requirements for the onboarding endpoints.
